 Jabari Smith Jr. delivers double-double in Monday's win 
 by Nate Miller | Rockets Correspondent | Tue, Oct 27th 2026, 10:38am EDT 
 Jabari Smith Jr. finished with 16 points (6-13 FG, 2-6 3PT, 2-3 FT), 12 rebounds, and five assists in Monday's 120-110 win over the Hawks. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Smith rounded out his stat line with a steal and a block, as he contributed across the board on Monday night. The fifth-year pro put up 30 points on opening night, but this was his highest point total since, and he also recorded his first double-double of the season. Smith's output could greatly vary on a game-to-game basis, but he should remain a solid fantasy asset with value in multiple columns throughout the season.
